Show HN: Simple DeepSeek web search CLI written in TypeScript (fast/cheap)
items.summary: If you've been following along with DeepSeek news you will know they recently added web search capability to the DeepSeek API, where you can use web search under the same API key. It is pretty handy, also super cheap at only $0.75 per 1,000 requests (pretty much as cheap as it gets, one search credit can encompass many responses). I created a simple TypeScript CLI wrapper around the API for my own agents to use (for open source models and harnesses) I'm sure most of you could whip this up on your own but it also comes with unit/integration/live/e2e testing, CI checks, changelog, auth handling, linting, sdk wrapper, and a fleshed out readme, potentially saving you a few hours of work + validation. Just need to install, auth, and drop a comment in your 'AGENTS.md' to use `dsearch --help` when agent needs web search. GitHub: https://github.com/LaishGlenberg/deepseek-search-cli
